content.short: xToken Terminal provides powerful, configurable smart contracts and a rich UX to give on-chain projects access to liquidity mining and token fundraising.
content.description: On-chain projects typically need access to financial primitives such as liquidity mining and token fundraising. xToken Terminal offers a powerful, configurable smart contract architecture and a rich UX to give projects and their communities access to these primitives in a few clicks.
